alreadyBlocked.title: Already Blocked
alreadyBlocked.description: True when the card was already Blocked and was not changed.

blockCaseNumber.title: Block Case Number
blockCaseNumber.description: Case number for the Card Block case.

fraudCaseNumber.title: Fraud Case Number
fraudCaseNumber.description: Case number for the Fraud Report case. Empty when no fraud report was created.

needsChoice.title: Needs Choice
needsChoice.description: True when more than one card matches and the customer must choose.

success.title: Success
success.description: True when an Active card was set to Blocked.
